title: Venezuelan Falafel Bowl
description: A flavorful and nutritious bowl filled with crispy falafel, fresh herbs, and a hint of Venezuelan spices. Serve as a snack or light lunch.
instructions: 2. Cook the herbal kissed rice according to package instructions.
3. In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
4. Add the falafel and cook until crispy and golden brown, about 5 minutes.
5. Add the thawed Venezuelan bowl corn to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
6. Stir in lime juice and season with salt to taste.
7. To assemble the bowls, place a scoop of cooked rice on the bottom, followed by the falafel and corn mixture.
8. Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve immediately.
